enrichment.headline: Adds $2,900 to Servio Consulting's contract to update the COVID Daily Assessment survey
enrichment.summary: The district is adding $2,900 to its agreement with Servio Consulting, which raises the cap from $35,000 to $37,900. The company will reprogram the COVID Daily Assessment survey so later questions depend on earlier answers, across web, text and voice. The work covers September 1, 2020 through June 30, 2021.
